name: HCG+β Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of HCG+β using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG) in human serum or plasma. This test is used as an aid in pregnancy test. For professional and laboratory use. This test can NOT be used to guide the diagnosis of pair trisomy 21.
